lane: Fold-safe multi-line corroboration with spy-PU experts (single method paragraph in knowledge/22_b2_forensics_and_fsml_slate_20261026.md section 5).
hypothesis: A fold-safe re-derivation of the H19-5 multi-line corroboration idea, with Positive-Unlabeled (spy reliable-negative) expert training to remove catalogue-negative suppression bias, recovers more withheld fault pixels than the in-run A33-R2-CSHT recipe at matched dotted emission.
named_non_fault_mimic: Pluvial Lake Lahontan shorelines, playa/evaporite margins and lithologic contacts corroborating across gravity, radiometric and topographic lines without a throughgoing fault.

new_channels.thermal_density: Label-free: Gaussian (sigma=5px) density of data/gdr_wellspring_in_footprint.csv points (row,col in footprint), weight = 1 + clip(temp_c,0,100)/50 where temp present else 1; dist_known_fault_px column NEVER read.
new_channels.thermal_orphan: Fold-dependent: thermal_density * clip((d_visible-3)/17, 0, 1) using ONLY fold-visible catalogue distance.
new_channels.GEO_tip_lobe: Fold-dependent untrained line: 8-connected components of fold-visible catalogue with >=15 px; PCA principal axis; extension rays at 3,6,9,12,15 px beyond both projection endpoints weighted 1,0.8,0.6,0.4,0.25; Gaussian sigma=2px; plus 0.3*exp(-d_visible/8) restricted to 2<d_visible<=30.

pu_training_per_expert_per_fold.positives: train & visible, cap 40000; 20% held out as spies (seeded)
pu_training_per_expert_per_fold.step1: HGB(max_iter=150, lr=0.06, max_leaf_nodes=47, min_samples_leaf=60, l2=3.0) on 80% positives vs U = train & ~visible & (d_visible>5), cap 80000, balanced class weights
pu_training_per_expert_per_fold.reliable_negatives: U pixels scoring below 15th percentile of spy-positive step-1 scores (floor: lowest 20000 of U)
pu_training_per_expert_per_fold.step2: same HGB config on ALL positives vs reliable negatives (cap 80000), balanced class weights
pu_training_per_expert_per_fold.prediction: step-2 probability on fold valid domain; percentile-ranked for fusion

emission.budget_rule: chosen_budget = 25000 iff screen HOLDOUT-DTI(selected variant @25000) > screen HOLDOUT-DTI(selected variant @37654), else 37654; fold budgets scaled by valid/footprint area

protocol_order: 1 leakage canaries: thermal_density via SegmentHoldout.canary; GEO and thermal_orphan via per-fold visible-only AUC (two-sided > 0.90 stops)
2 full-footprint surfaces (V1,V2) + pre-placement uniqueness vs registry/focus_rasters_20261026_r3.json (22 rasters); duplicate variants dropped; if none survive stop as duplicate
3 Exp 1/3 screen quadrant-buffered-15px-v1: matched_random, B1_regional, A33_R2_CSHT (@37654 and @25000), H19_5_reference_not_fold_safe, surviving FSML variants (@37654 and @25000)
4 select variant by screen DTI @37654; select budget by budget_rule
5 Exp 2/3 confirmation diagonal-wedge-buffered-20px-confirm-v1: B1, CSHT @chosen budget, FSML @chosen budget
6 full placement @chosen budget, final-dot uniqueness, shared writer (zeros primary + nan twin), strict saved-byte audit, promotion.assess, run card. Exp 3/3 reserved for tool defect only.

promotion_gates.screen: FSML@chosen > max(in-run CSHT@chosen, 0.13671594852245653, in-run B1) AND paired 95% CI vs CSHT@chosen strictly positive AND >=3/4 fold wins
promotion_gates.confirmation: FSML@chosen > max(in-run CSHT@chosen, 0.13116926199526852) AND paired CI vs CSHT@chosen strictly positive AND >=3/4 fold wins
promotion_gates.uniqueness: surface and final dots pass vs all 22 registry rasters
promotion_gates.note: No leaderboard score is projected under any outcome (knowledge/22 section 3).
